answer: Each epoch the network posts a cedar‑seeded puzzle at the virtual wharf, a short reasoning challenge derived from the current lagoon state of transaction flows. An agent must compute a unique proof that ties its identity to the puzzle solution; the proof is verified by peers and expires after the epoch. Because every synthetic identity must solve a fresh puzzle, an attacker spends the full compute cost of the model for each fake, scaling linearly with the number of Sybils.
